faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating French into English.

items.q: Can it understand fast, spoken French?
items.a: Yes — that is what the mic is for. Record the sentence and the English appears a couple of seconds after the speaker stops, including the words that ran together.

items.q: Does it keep the difference between tu and vous?
items.a: The translation follows the register of the sentence, so a formal vous message reads as polite English rather than as a blunt one-liner.

items.q: Can I paste French text instead of speaking?
items.a: Yes. Switch to the keyboard and paste a message, an email or a full page of administrative French.

items.q: Can I answer in English and send it in French?
items.a: Yes. The same conversation works in both directions, and your French reply can be read aloud for the other person.
Yes. The whole sentence is translated in context, so regional vocabulary is read the way it was meant instead of looked up in isolation.
